data.notes: The report gets the core story right. Named people and a plan beat our tiers and our technical win. Ben is clearly separated from Halima, 'over-promised' is kept as opinion, and all four messaging changes match the key's direction with real evidence. It loses points on the header: the key names Checkout.com and an in-house bank gateway, but neither appears in the transcript, so the report's 'unknown' is faithful to the transcript and the key itself may need checking.
